title: Gap-free odd-Matsubara resolvent telescoping budget
question: Can the exact resolvent difference identity give a summable, gap-free budget for the resolvent part of the positive Matsubara kernel while isolating the absolute-value square-root term as a separate locality obligation?
promotion_boundary: R-377 is a finite exact resolvent-algebra and budget interface. It isolates the resolvent contribution and records the absolute-value square-root contribution, but proves no uniform locality, common core, common alpha or QFT limit.
next_action: Prove a source-, volume- and cutoff-uniform energy-constrained bound for the isolated square-root/local commutator term and then sum the resolvent layers on the common polynomial core.
boundary: Finite V=2, cutoff 2 doubled-bond Liouvillian comparisons with two beta values, two perturbation scales and 64 odd frequencies. The identity and finite budgets are checked numerically and in Lean; source/volume/cutoff uniformity, resolvent locality, common core, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS dynamics, gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A and Pre-A remain open.
